§6Shredder§f

§aDouble your ore output. Or turn everything into scrap. Your call.§f

The §bShredder§f crushes ores into powder. Ore in, 2 powder out, smelt for 2 ingots. Equip two §bShredder Blades§f and give it power.

Craft it at the assembly machine: steel plates ×8, copper plates ×4, motors ×2.

§6Blade Durability§f:
§b• Steel§f: 200
§b• Titanium§f: 350
§b• Advanced Alloy§f: 700
§b• Desh§f: Unbreakable

Spread input across all 9 slots to reduce blade and power cost per item. Items without a powder form come out as §bscrap§f.

§cWARNING:§f Never re-shred scrap. The dust is inferior to just smelting the scrap directly.
